notes.title: New options for each game
notes.content:
- Added two new options of game available when you select the number of characters.
1) Now you can remove hungry system and foods.
2) Also, you can choose to auto-regenerate all health and mana at the after each completion of the map.
These options give you a negative percentage of points on hall of fame.
- Added hidden treasures. You can find them with ability PERCEPTION

notes.title: Fixed the clicks-on-map bug of some device.
notes.content:
- Fixed the clicks-on-map bug of some device.
- Now you can drag and move the map using central mouse button.
- You can see info on map directly with the right mouse button. Also you can continue the use the button "look" (or hotkey "L").
- Fixed the particle effect of spells when zoom is too big.
- Minor bugs fixed.
